Both pilocarpine and 2-Methylbenzofuran are known to interact with Aconitate hydratase, mitochondrial, indicating a potential mechanism by which Fosnetupitant may influence this enzyme. The integration of these targets highlights a possible pathway where Fosnetupitant indirectly affects Aconitate hydratase, mitochondrial through the intermediacy of Alpha-actinin-1 and its downstream targets. The evidence supports a functional link between Fosnetupitant and Aconitate hydratase, mitochondrial, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
